title: Weak convergence survives translations and dilations with factors tending to 1
statement: Let P, n, Q ∈ ℕ and μ := μH[n] on ℝ^P. Let g_k : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q (k ∈ ℕ) be locally μ-integrable, let g : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be arbitrary, let y ∈ ℝ^P, and let c_k > 0 with c_k → 1. Suppose ∫ f g_k dμ → ∫ f g dμ for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ. Then for every such f, ∫ f(x) g_k(y + c_k x) dμ(x) → ∫ f(x) g(y + x) dμ(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n Q : ℕ) (gs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid Q) (g : Euclid P → Euclid Q) (y : Euclid P) (mus : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, LocallyIntegrable (gs k) μH[(n : ℝ)]) → (∀ k, 0 < mus k) → Tendsto mus atTop (𝓝 1) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x • gs k x ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x • g x ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]))) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x • gs k (y + mus k • x) ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x • g (y + x) ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]))
